mapper.select: SELECT m.api_model AS apiModel, m.provider_code AS providerCode, m.provider_name AS providerName, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.ext_json, '$.maxContextTokens')) AS SIGNED) AS maxContextTokens, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.ext_json, '$.maxOutputTokens')) AS SIGNED) AS maxOutputTokens, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.ext_json, '$.priority')) AS SIGNED) AS priority FROM ai_model_config m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.ext_json, '$.priority')) AS SIGNED), 100) ASC, m.update_time DESC, m.id DESC
